text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱسْتَبَقَا ٱلْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُۥ مِن دُبُرٍۢ وَأَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا ٱلْبَابِ ۚ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَآءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوٓءًا إِلَّآ أَن يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: continuing connector that resumes the prior scene and launches immediate motion
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the verse moving from the prior scene instead of restarting it. The connector pushes the reader straight into the escape beat, so moral protection in 12:24 becomes visible motion in 12:25.

topics.headline: continuation that launches motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as linked continuation and immediate motion, not as an isolated restart.
topics.reason: The initial connector joins the prior scene to the first racing action and is locally supported by the opening coordinated clause.

words.gloss_range: dual reciprocal racing toward a contested endpoint, with physical action preceding accusation
words.root_gloss_range: preceding, outstripping, racing, and priority; local Form X dual selects reciprocal racing toward the door
words.prose: {{ar:اسْتَبَقَا}} ({{tr:istabaqā}}) is dual and reciprocal: exactly two people race one another toward the same endpoint. Because this first lexical action comes before the tearing, discovery, and speech, the reader receives the physical evidence before the accusation; the racing root also recalls the brothers' alibi language in 12:17, though here the race is visible rather than merely reported.

topics.headline: dual reciprocal race toward one endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exactly two actors competing for the same threshold, not a generic flight scene.
topics.reason: The QAC and verb-instance evidence mark a Form X dual verb with the door as object/goal.

topics.headline: physical action before accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader receives action and evidence before the woman's speech frames the event.
topics.reason: The clause order places racing before tearing, discovery, and direct speech.

topics.headline: same-surah racing echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the racing field against 12:17, while local grammar still selects the visible race in this scene.
topics.reason: The 12:17 echo is concrete and useful; the 46:11 and co-occurrence material are broader and remain background rather than controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: the known, singular door as goal-object and threshold of exposure
words.root_gloss_range: door, gate, entry, and access-point range; local concrete noun selects the known physical threshold
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَابَ}} ({{tr:al-bāba}}) is not any door; it is the known threshold and the accusative goal of the race. The first door occurrence makes the exit a finish line, while the later door at word 13 turns that motion into exposure at the same threshold. The door motif also reaches back to locked enclosure in 12:23 and forward to strategic doors in 12:67, but here the local payoff is the contested escape threshold.

topics.headline: known door as race goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one specific, bounded threshold as the contested endpoint of escape.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, singular, accusative, and attached as the race goal.

topics.headline: door as disclosure hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first door planting the hinge that will close when the master is found at the same door.
topics.reason: The local repetition at words 3 and 13 turns motion to the door into encounter at the door.

topics.headline: surah and wider door motifs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect this door to locked enclosure in 12:23 and strategic doors in 12:67 without letting those scenes replace the local threshold.
topics.reason: The references support motif pressure; local grammar still selects the concrete door of this scene.

words.gloss_range: connector that inserts the tearing as sequential action and circumstance within the chase
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) attaches the tearing to the chase without letting the action pause. It can be heard as sequence and circumstance together: the torn shirt enters the chain while the race is still narratively hot. As the middle onset in the repeated connector pattern at words 1, 4, and 9, it also helps the race, tear, and discovery arrive with quick cadence.

topics.headline: tear linked into chase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tearing as both part of the sequence and the circumstance explaining the shirt evidence.
topics.reason: The second connector coordinates the tearing clause after the race and before the encounter.

topics.headline: repeated connector cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the three action onsets as a quick narrative chain.
topics.reason: The sound row has modest payoff but is concrete and tied to the repeated local connectors.

words.gloss_range: completed feminine tearing action, directionally and forensically marked before speech
words.root_gloss_range: cutting or tearing lengthwise and related strip imagery; local perfect verb selects completed tearing
words.prose: {{ar:قَدَّتْ}} ({{tr:qaddat}}) grammatically names the woman as the tearer before she speaks. The completed, lengthwise tearing gives the shirt a force-vector from behind, and the same root becomes the front/back test in 12:26-28. Its doubled stop makes the ripping action sound compressed, while the rare verbal use keeps that tearing sense concentrated at the forensic center.

topics.headline: woman marked as tearer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees her agency encoded in the verb before her accusation tries to redirect blame.
topics.reason: The 3fs perfect morphology identifies the woman as subject of the tearing action.

topics.headline: lengthwise tear as force evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tear as a directional, strip-like split rather than generic damage.
topics.reason: The root evidence and the governed rear phrase support lengthwise directional tearing.

topics.headline: completed evidence before speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader receives the torn-shirt fact as settled before the legal-looking speech begins.
topics.reason: The perfect verb and clause order place the completed tear before the quotation.

topics.headline: tear root becomes verdict test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word beginning the front/back evidence sequence resolved in 12:26-28.
topics.reason: The same-scene recurrence is concrete and directly tied to the shirt evidence.

topics.headline: sharp sound and rare verbal use
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear the compressed doubled consonant and note the rare verbal concentration, while these features support texture rather than proving meaning.
topics.reason: The sound and rarity claims are locally tied to the verb but should remain secondary to grammar and direction.

words.gloss_range: Joseph's concrete shirt as the affected evidence-bearing garment
words.root_gloss_range: shirt or body garment in the Joseph narrative; local possessed object makes the garment evidence
words.prose: {{ar:قَمِيصَهُ}} ({{tr:qamīṣahu}}) binds the garment to Joseph by suffix and makes it the affected object of her tearing. The shirt is a concrete, body-worn surface on which direction and force become inspectable, and its motion-image makes it feel catchable as Joseph moves. It also continues the Joseph-shirt motif from false blood in 12:18 to later recognition and healing in 12:93.

topics.headline: his shirt as affected object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the evidence object bound to Joseph even while the action belongs to her.
topics.reason: The suffix marks Joseph as owner and the noun is the direct object of the tearing verb.

topics.headline: concrete garment records direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the body-worn shirt as the material surface on which direction and force become inspectable.
topics.reason: The local object sits between tear verb and rear phrase, and collocates with tearing/back evidence in the scene.

topics.headline: Joseph shirt motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this shirt to the Joseph narrative's evidence chain from 12:18 through 12:93.
topics.reason: The shirt lexeme is concentrated in Surah 12 and repeatedly functions as evidence.

topics.headline: garment catchable in motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may picture the body-covering seized during motion, while the local sense remains simply the shirt.
topics.reason: The root-image claim is plausible as image pressure but does not replace the local garment sense.

words.gloss_range: source-direction preposition marking where the tear begins or is read from
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) gives the tear its source direction: the evidence is read from the rear side. The small preposition makes the following back-reference forensic rather than decorative.

topics.headline: source direction of the tear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes the rear phrase a source-direction marker for the tear.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the rear noun as the source direction of the tearing action.

words.gloss_range: rear or back side as governed directional evidence, left indefinite but decisive
words.root_gloss_range: back, rear, aftermath, turning away, and consequence; local phrase selects rear-side direction as forensic evidence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source-direction preposition governing the rear phrase

words.prose: {{ar:دُبُرٍ}} ({{tr:duburin}}) names the rear side under {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}), so the grammar turns direction into evidence. Its standard genitive indefiniteness avoids over-specifying a body part, while the variant apparatus tests that case relation without displacing the governed parse. The rear/back field links this tear to the verdict language of 12:27-28.

topics.headline: rear side governed by source preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a grammatically governed rear-side phrase that is decisive without over-specifying the body part.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the source preposition and indefinite in the standard local phrase.

topics.headline: back direction becomes verdict evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the back direction turning flight into exculpatory evidence and anticipating the verdict direction in 12:27-28.
topics.reason: The root field and same-scene recurrence support rear/back consequence pressure while local grammar selects the rear side.

topics.headline: case variant as apparatus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that variant evidence tests the case relation, while the standard reading keeps the phrase governed by the preposition.
topics.reason: The variant is useful as contrast but does not control the canonical genitive parse.

words.gloss_range: connector that resumes the event chain from torn evidence to encounter
words.prose: The third {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) moves from the torn-evidence clause into the encounter at the door. The repeated connector pattern makes the race, tear, and discovery arrive as rapid coordinated beats.

topics.headline: connector from evidence to encounter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sequence pivot from torn evidence to the master's appearance before speech starts.
topics.reason: The connector coordinates the third event after the tearing clause.

topics.headline: audible three-beat action chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated connector onsets bind race, tear, and discovery.
topics.reason: The cadence row is local and concrete, though secondary.

words.gloss_range: dual discovery or encounter of someone already present, opening the speech hinge
words.root_gloss_range: finding, encountering, or coming upon what is present; local Form IV dual selects sudden discovery at the threshold
words.prose: {{ar:أَلْفَيَا}} ({{tr:alfayā}}) keeps the two racers as the subject but shifts the scene from pursuit to sudden encounter. The verb suggests finding someone already there, and its rare Quranic pattern leads directly into speech here and in the inherited-finding scene of 2:170.

topics.headline: both racers meet the authority figure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Joseph and the woman arriving into the discovery together, not one of them narrating it later.
topics.reason: The verb is dual perfect with the same pair continued from the chase.

topics.headline: finding someone already at the door
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the master as encountered at the threshold, apparently already there, rather than introduced by generic finding.
topics.reason: The verb takes the master as object and the door phrase as location; lexical evidence supports encounter/finding what is present.

topics.headline: rare discovery verb leading to speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the rare discovery verb as a hinge into speech, with 2:170 as a concrete comparison, while the local scene remains the controlling frame.
topics.reason: The rarity and 2:170 echo are real but background the local discovery and accusation sequence.

words.gloss_range: her master or lordly authority figure, framed through her possessive relation rather than a spouse label
words.root_gloss_range: mastery, authority, dominance, and lordly status; local possessed title selects the woman's authority relation
words.prose: {{ar:سَيِّدَهَا}} ({{tr:sayyidahā}}) identifies the man through her relation to him, as master or authority-holder rather than simply spouse. The possessive suffix makes the social jurisdiction visible at the exact moment she redirects accusation toward Joseph. The dominance field behind the title remains pressure rather than a new sense, and the authority term can be compared with accusation about leaders in 33:67 without changing this local referent.

topics.headline: her master as authority relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the man is framed through mastery and her possessive relation, not merely as husband.
topics.reason: The noun is the object of the discovery verb and carries a 3fs suffix attached to an authority title.

topics.headline: dominance imagery behind title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels jurisdictional authority in the title, while blackness or sound imagery remains secondary pressure rather than a separate local sense.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure supports the social dominance of the title but does not replace the local master sense.

topics.headline: authority term in accusation contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare the authority term with accusation about leaders in 33:67, while this scene still names the woman's local authority figure.
topics.reason: The 33:67 comparison is concrete but functions as echo, not local referent.

words.gloss_range: near-presence locative placing the encounter immediately at the threshold
words.prose: {{ar:لَدَى}} ({{tr:ladā}}) places the discovery in immediate nearness, not vague location. The master is encountered right at the threshold, so the escape point becomes the confrontation point. The long ā cadence across the discovery phrase is secondary, but it lets the phrase land as a held locative beat.

topics.headline: immediate nearness at the door
topics.reader_payoff: The reader locates the encounter at immediate threshold-nearness rather than a loose at-phrase.
topics.reason: The adverb governs the door as its genitive complement and supplies place for the discovery verb.

topics.headline: long-vowel cadence in discovery phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a local cadence across the discovery phrase, though it remains secondary to location.
topics.reason: The sound row is local and does not conflict with grammar.

words.gloss_range: the same known door now as genitive location rather than motion goal
words.root_gloss_range: door, gate, entry, and access-point range; local genitive noun selects the same threshold as location
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَابِ}} ({{tr:al-bābi}}) repeats the same definite door, now governed as location after {{ar:لَدَى}} ({{tr:ladā}}). The case shift from goal at word 3 to location here closes the motion frame before the accusation begins.

topics.headline: same door becomes location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first door goal return as the location that closes the movement frame.
topics.reason: The repeated definite noun is genitive after the locative and corresponds to the earlier accusative door.

topics.headline: locked enclosure becomes exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the door motif from the locked scene in 12:23 to public exposure here.
topics.reason: The same surah motif is concrete and locally meaningful.

words.gloss_range: her completed saying, switching from narrated evidence into direct legal-looking speech
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speaking, and reported utterance; local feminine perfect introduces the woman's direct quote
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَتْ}} ({{tr:qālat}}) switches the channel from narrated facts into the woman's direct speech. Its feminine form assigns the accusation to her, and its placement after race, tear, and discovery means the reader has the evidence before hearing the legal-looking claim. The she-said frame is immediately answered by the masculine reply in 12:26 and later reframed by her speech in 12:32, while broader speech-register and sound pressure remain background.

topics.headline: woman assigned direct speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows from the verb form itself that she is the speaker who now frames the event.
topics.reason: The 3fs perfect speech verb introduces the quoted complement.

topics.headline: speech becomes legal-looking accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a channel shift from narration into a legal-sounding quoted accusation.
topics.reason: The speech verb governs the rhetorical question as direct quotation.

topics.headline: speech after physical evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears her claim only after the narrative has already shown race, tear, and discovery.
topics.reason: The event order places direct speech after the physical evidence chain.

topics.headline: she-said answered by he-said
topics.reader_payoff: The reader anticipates the immediate rebuttal pattern in 12:26 after her accusation in 12:25 and her later admission context in 12:32.
topics.reason: The next-ayah speech mirror is concrete and locally adjacent.

topics.headline: broad speech register and sound texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear formal speech pressure, while broad divine-speech co-occurrence and phonetic interruption remain secondary.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence is too broad to control local meaning but can remain as background texture.

words.gloss_range: interrogative opening whose question force functions rhetorically under the later restriction
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens a question, but the later exception turns it into a controlled accusation rather than a request for information. The form lets the speech sound interrogative while already steering the answer.

topics.headline: question that performs accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech is grammatically a question but pragmatically an accusation with a built-in answer.
topics.reason: The interrogative opens a nominal question whose force is restricted by the following exception construction.

words.gloss_range: recompense or fitting return framed as a legal category inside the rhetorical question
words.root_gloss_range: recompense, return, payment, or fitting requital; local construct selects penalty logic

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative whoever governed by the recompense construct

words.prose: {{ar:جَزَآءُ}} ({{tr:jazāʾu}}) makes the question about fitting recompense, not a raw outburst. As a construct with {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}), it packages the accusation as a general penalty formula, with parallels in later Joseph-scene questioning in 12:74-75. The same recompense field later turns toward need and reward in 12:88, so the local punitive use is not the root's whole story.

topics.headline: recompense as question predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the charge framed as fitting recompense and legal category rather than personal panic.
topics.reason: The noun is the predicate of the interrogative and heads a construct with the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: recompense formula and Joseph echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the penalty formula to later Joseph-scene questioning in 12:74-75 and to reward language in 12:88, while the local use remains punitive.
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah references support formula pressure without overriding the local accusation.

words.gloss_range: relative whoever that generalizes and anonymizes the accused person while still targeting Joseph
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) avoids naming Joseph while making him fit the legal category of whoever did such a thing. That anonymity lets the woman sound principled while still directing judgment at the man before them.

topics.headline: whoever names a type while targeting Joseph
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Joseph unnamed and categorized as whoever would do this, allowing a specific accusation to sound general.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is governed by the recompense construct and serves as subject of the relative verb.

words.gloss_range: Form IV intending or seeking harm against a target, with the alleged will made accusatory content
words.root_gloss_range: seeking, wanting, intending, and directing will; local Form IV with object and target selects alleged intent to harm
words.prose: {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}) shifts the charge into alleged intent: someone wanted harm against the master's household. The Form IV verb selects intention here, while the wider seeking root recalls the seduction vocabulary of 12:23, 12:30, 12:32, and 12:51 that her wording tries to reverse.

topics.headline: alleged intent with target and object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the accusation moved into alleged inner will directed against the household.
topics.reason: The verb takes the relative pronoun as subject, the harm noun as object, and the household as prepositional target.

topics.headline: Form IV intention from seeking field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the seeking background behind the intention verb, while the local Form IV selects intending.
topics.reason: The root pressure survives as background because local form and valency select intent.

topics.headline: surah recurrence reverses seducer and accused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root tied to solicitation in 12:23, 12:30, 12:32, and 12:51 is repurposed here to accuse Joseph of intent.
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence is concrete and central to the accusation reversal.

words.gloss_range: targeting preposition that directs the alleged harm toward the master's household
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marks the target of the alleged harm before the harm noun appears. It makes the accusation feel directed against the household domain, not merely attached to a vague bad act.

topics.headline: household target before harm noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the target of the alleged harm before the harm itself is named.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the household phrase as complement of the intent verb.

words.gloss_range: your household or wife as possessed social domain addressed directly to the master
words.root_gloss_range: family, household, people, or wife depending on relation; local construct with second-person suffix selects the master's household domain
words.prose: {{ar:أَهْلِكَ}} ({{tr:ahlika}}) turns the charge into an offense against your household, addressing the master directly through the suffix and appealing to his authority and honor. The word can include wife and household together, so she refers to herself obliquely through his social domain rather than saying me.

topics.headline: your household addresses the master
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the woman appeal to the master's ownership and honor through the second-person suffix.
topics.reason: The construct with 2ms suffix is governed by the targeting preposition.

topics.headline: wife and household kept together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees her refer to herself obliquely as part of his household domain rather than naming herself.
topics.reason: The local referent permits wife/household overlap, while wider references such as 11:45-46 show the term's social-boundary force.

words.gloss_range: broad, morally charged harm or evil, intentionally unspecified in the accusation
words.root_gloss_range: evil, harm, badness, and moral injury; local indefinite object keeps the alleged harm broad
words.prose: {{ar:سُوٓءًا}} ({{tr:sūʾan}}) keeps the alleged act broad: harm, evil, and moral injury are all left unspecified. That vagueness matters because 12:24 has just said evil was turned away from Joseph, while 12:25 puts the same harm field into her reversed accusation. The stretched vowel and hamza make the harm word feel prolonged and then stopped, a sound texture that supports the broad charge without adding a new sense.

topics.headline: unspecified harm or evil
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the allegation stays morally charged but strategically unspecific.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite accusative object of the intent verb and does not specify the alleged act.

topics.headline: averted evil becomes accused evil
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the harm field reverse from what was turned away from Joseph in 12:24 into what he is accused of intending in 12:25.
topics.reason: The adjacent root recurrence and wider harm-punishment field are concrete and central to the accusation.

topics.headline: stretched and stopped harm word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear the harm noun as stretched and arrested, while sound remains texture rather than a separate semantic branch.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local but secondary.

words.gloss_range: exception particle that restricts the rhetorical question into its proposed answer
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}) converts the question into a restricted answer. The particle narrows the range of recompense to the penalties that follow, so the speech asks while already sentencing.

topics.headline: exception supplies the answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question closes around its own proposed penalties.
topics.reason: The exception particle marks the imprisonment clause as the restricted answer from the recompense frame.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle that nominalizes the imprisonment clause as a penalty option

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: passive subjunctive imprisonment verb made dependent by the subordinator

words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) makes the imprisonment verb function like a selectable penalty item after the exception. It keeps {{ar:يُسْجَنَ}} ({{tr:yusjana}}) dependent, not an independent report that imprisonment is already happening.

topics.headline: subordinator turns imprisonment into option
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a verbal imprisonment event compressed into a noun-like penalty item after the exception.
topics.reason: The particle governs the passive subjunctive as a dependent punishment clause.

words.gloss_range: passive subjunctive imprisonment proposal, impersonal in agent and concrete in confinement
words.root_gloss_range: confinement, prison, and being shut in; local passive subjunctive selects proposed imprisonment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative whoever that keeps the alleged culprit unnamed

words.prose: {{ar:يُسْجَنَ}} ({{tr:yusjana}}) is passive and subjunctive, so the proposed imprisonment sounds like an impersonal legal outcome rather than a direct command naming an imprisoner. With {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) also leaving the culprit unnamed, the speech hides agents on both sides while still steering judgment toward Joseph. It is also the first penalty slot, planting the prison arc that returns in 12:32, 12:33, 12:36, 12:42, and 12:100.

topics.headline: impersonal proposed imprisonment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both the culprit and the imprisoning agent are grammatically obscured while the sentence still aims at Joseph.
topics.reason: The form is passive subjunctive under the subordinator, and the relative culprit is unnamed.

topics.headline: confinement as first penalty slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speech narrow first to confinement before opening the alternative of painful punishment.
topics.reason: The verb follows the exception and precedes the disjunction as the first proposed penalty.

topics.headline: imprisonment seed of Joseph arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the threat planting the prison path that returns in 12:32, 12:33, 12:36, 12:42, and 12:100.
topics.reason: The same-surah prison recurrence is concrete and narratively major.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive connector making a penalty range between imprisonment and painful punishment
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) turns the proposed punishment into an option-set. It joins imprisonment to a painful punishment while leaving the two alternatives grammatically uneven, which makes the second sound like escalation as well as choice.

topics.headline: choice and escalation between penalties
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the accusation offer a sentencing range, with the second item sounding escalated and grammatically unlike the first.
topics.reason: The disjunction coordinates the passive verbal penalty with a nominative nominal punishment phrase.

words.gloss_range: open-ended punishment or torment noun, nominative and formulaic with the pain adjective
words.root_gloss_range: punishment, torment, and inflicted suffering; local noun selects a painful penalty category

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: pain adjective agreeing with the punishment noun

words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) escalates the speech from confinement to inflicted suffering. Its nominative indefiniteness leaves the punishment open-ended, while the standard nominative also resists perfect parallel with the preceding verbal penalty; the shawadhdh accusative shows the smoother alternative without governing the local reading. The phrase with {{ar:أَلِيمٌ}} ({{tr:alīmun}}) borrows a divine-warning formula heard in contexts such as 11:26, 11:48, and 15:50.

topics.headline: nominative punishment resists perfect parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second penalty as formulaically strong but grammatically marked against the preceding verbal clause.
topics.reason: The canonical nominative agrees with the adjective; the shawadhdh accusative is useful contrast but does not govern the local reading.

topics.headline: unspecified inflicted punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an open-ended category of inflicted suffering after the more concrete prison option.
topics.reason: The indefinite noun abstracts torment into a punishment category.

topics.headline: divine punishment formula borrowed by accuser
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a human accuser borrowing punishment diction familiar from divine warning contexts such as 11:26, 11:48, and 15:50.
topics.reason: The noun-adjective pair is formulaic and the cited references make the register shift concrete.

words.gloss_range: intensive painful adjective agreeing with punishment and sealing the threat formula
words.root_gloss_range: pain, painfulness, and pain-causing intensity; local adjective qualifies the punishment as severe

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: punishment noun qualified by the pain adjective

words.prose: {{ar:أَلِيمٌ}} ({{tr:alīmun}}) agrees with {{ar:عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) and makes pain the final quality of the threat. Its intensive form leaves the pain severe, unspecified, and both pain-bearing and pain-causing. The formulaic pairing and final indefinite cadence make the human accusation close with punishment diction familiar from divine-warning settings such as 10:88 and 15:50.

topics.headline: pain adjective fused to punishment noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees pain grammatically fused to the punishment noun rather than standing as a separate claim.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the punishment noun in nominative indefiniteness.

topics.headline: intensive pain-causing quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the punishment qualified as severe, unspecified, and experientially painful.
topics.reason: The adjective form supports intensive pain quality and matches the indefinite threat.

topics.headline: formula and cadence seal the accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word closing the accusation with a formulaic punishment pair and an indefinite cadence, with divine-warning parallels such as 10:88 and 15:50.
topics.reason: The pair is highly formulaic and the final position seals the quoted speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The mutual race, doubled door, longitudinal rear tear, garment, finding, and master all occur inside 12:25.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two opposed trajectories converge at a boundary. The grasp from behind leaves the relative direction of the bodies in the shirt, and finding the master at the same door converts that material trace into a latent case before either account is tested.

activation_trace.role: Supplies literal forward precedence and makes the movement a contest over who reaches the threshold first.
Supplies the physical entrance twice and makes one boundary both the goal of flight and the site of encounter.
Supplies a longitudinal split whose orientation can retain the force and direction of the pursuit.
Supplies the worn covering as the surface on which bodily motion leaves a portable trace.
Fixes the tear at the rear and therefore distinguishes pursuit from frontal approach.
Supplies the sudden finding that turns private motion into an exposed encounter.
Adds convergence: the fleeing pair and the arriving authority are joined at one narrow point.
Supplies household mastery and makes the accidental witness the immediate seat of jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: A chase ends when the pair happen to meet the master at the door.
changed_reading.after: The escape line writes directional evidence into the garment and deposits it at a jurisdictional threshold before speech can classify the event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Her utterance moves from recompense, to an attributed intention against the household, to an exclusive choice of imprisonment or pain.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question is syntactically a near-verdict: it presupposes an offender and injured household, assigns an evil intention, and narrows the response to two sanctions. Speech therefore becomes a second race, seeking interpretive precedence over the unsorted material scene.

activation_trace.role: Supplies speech used to transact an affair and makes her first utterance a bid to settle the case.
Supplies act-for-act repayment and lets the question frame punishment as already deserved equivalence.
Adds a struggle for dominance within requital, matching the attempt to control who gets to define the offense.
Supplies inward intention as the invisible fact her formulation asserts rather than demonstrates.
Supplies the intimate household group and lets her speak as its injured inside member.
Supplies injurious harm while leaving its concrete content unspecified enough for the accusation to control it.
Supplies confinement as the first preselected outcome.
Supplies punitive infliction as the only stated alternative to confinement.
Makes inflicted pain the defining quality of the alternative sanction.

changed_reading.before: She accuses him and suggests possible punishments.
changed_reading.after: She compresses perpetrator, victim group, motive, equivalence, and sentence into one leading question, trying to win the interpretive race at the instant of exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse begins with a race to an opening and ends with a proposal to confine or painfully restrain the racer.
baseline_models.mechanism: The door and prison are opposed spatial technologies. Movement aims at a passage, but the encounter at that passage lets speech translate attempted exit into threatened enclosure; the verse pivots from mobility to immobilization.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the possibility of escaping a pursuer and gives the opening urgency as a route beyond capture.
Makes the repeated door a limit or frontier where private control changes into household authority.
Supplies the closed place that negates the passage toward which the race was directed.
Adds durable immobilization, extending a momentary interception into a condition meant to hold.
Supplies restraint and deprivation as a second way of blocking the threatened person's agency.

changed_reading.before: The door belongs to the chase, while prison belongs to the later accusation.
changed_reading.after: A contested opening is verbally converted into enclosure: the physical route of escape becomes the jurisdictional point from which mobility can be revoked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence makes Joseph concealed merchandise, exchanges him, assigns a price, and diminishes his due. In 12:25 the language of recompense prices an alleged injury with a tariff of prison or pain, moving the same vulnerable body from commodity to penal debtor.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed reading in requital, the point where moral judgment can take a valuation-like form.
Supplies a piece of wealth turned into trade goods and activates the prior conversion of a person into merchandise.
Supplies commercial exchange and makes the earlier disposition of his body an explicit transaction.
Supplies assigned value and activates comparison with the punitive value proposed in the focus question.
Supplies diminution of a rightful measure and sharpens the asymmetry of both market and penal valuations.

structural_cues: 12:19-20 first conceal and price Joseph; 12:25 again assigns a consequence to his person through another party's speech.
The focus question uses equivalence language but supplies no inquiry into the alleged event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commodity, exchange, price, diminished due, and requital; I supply the analogy from market valuation to penal valuation. A live alternative is that the shared structure is narrative irony rather than a single continuous economic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The proposed sanctions are solely legal or affective responses to an alleged wrong.
changed_reading.after: The question also performs a valuation operation: a body once cheaply priced as merchandise is now assigned an inflated penal debt by the household that possesses him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The household earlier grants honorable lodging and entertains taking Joseph as a child or dependent. Her phrase 'your household' then redraws that porous relation: the honored resident is verbally repositioned as an external aggressor against the group.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the accusation in a group defined by intimacy, residence, and belonging rather than a merely abstract victim.
Supplies the master whose authority can ratify or reject the proposed boundary around his household.
Supplies honored treatment and makes his prior position inside the house more than that of a tolerated stranger.
Supplies settled residence, activating the house as Joseph's established dwelling as well as hers.
Supplies deliberate adoption or acquisition and activates a possible formal move into household membership.
Supplies the ambiguous category of young child or owned dependent through which intimacy and subordination coexist.

structural_cues: The purchaser speaks to his wife about Joseph's honorable lodging and possible incorporation before the focus encounter.
The focus accusation addresses the same man through the possessive boundary 'your household.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies residence, honor, taking-as-child, dependence, and household belonging; I infer that the accusation strategically redraws membership. A live alternative is that 'your household' refers narrowly to the wife, without making a claim about Joseph's resident status.

changed_reading.before: A household member reports an outsider's attack on the household.
changed_reading.after: The report actively manufactures that outsider position, excluding an honored resident or quasi-child from the belonging that had just been offered to him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the solicitation scene, judgment and knowledge accompany the declaration that good-doers are recompensed. The focus reuses recompense grammar but couples it to alleged evil and a humanly preselected sentence, creating rival moral accounts of the same person.

activation_trace.role: Anchors her question in act-for-act requital and exposes its claim to moral equivalence.
Supplies the negative moral classification that her recompense formula presupposes.
Supplies judgment as a preceding capacity and activates comparison with the summary judgment attempted in 12:25.
Repeats the same requital mechanism in a prior declaration whose evaluative subject is the good-doer.
Supplies enacted good and gives the prior recompense formula the opposite moral classification.

structural_cues: The focus question follows within three ayat of the formula 'We recompense the doers of good.'
Both formulations classify conduct and attach a consequence, but only the focus speaker names the sentence before evidence is examined.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated recompense root, prior judgment, good action, and the focus allegation of evil; I infer a competition between moral jurisdictions. The minimum alternative is deliberate verbal irony rather than an attempted substitution of one regime for another.

changed_reading.before: Her question invokes an ordinary household norm of punishment.
changed_reading.after: Her formula imitates the grammar of moral recompense while reversing its classification, attempting to replace the preceding 'good-doer' account with an 'intended evil' account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context names her as the soliciting subject behind tightly closed doors, then says evil is turned away from him. At the opened threshold her speech swaps the agency, attributing evil intention to him. The reversal is grammatical, spatial, and moral at once.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the accusation in attributed intention, the inner agency whose ownership is being contested.
Anchors the harmful predicate that her statement reattaches to him.
Supplies solicitation as a contest of wills with her as the explicit initiating subject.
Supplies deliberately secured closure and defines the private space in which the first agency relation is established.
Supplies the plural entrances under closure, which the focus's repeated singular threshold reopens to witness.
Supplies active diversion away from a target and makes moral distance from evil part of the immediate context.
Repeats the harmful predicate as something turned from him just before she attributes its intention to him.

structural_cues: 12:23 explicitly assigns solicitation to her; 12:25 assigns intended harm to him inside her quoted speech.
Many doors are closed in 12:23, while the door is reached and repeated in 12:25.
The same evil root occurs in 12:24 and 12:25 with opposite relations to Joseph.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two subject assignments, the closure-to-threshold sequence, and evil first diverted then alleged; I infer that the focus speech is a counternarrative generated at exposure. A live alternative is that she alleges a distinct act arising during the race rather than simply reversing the prior act.

changed_reading.before: Her accusation reports her interpretation of an ambiguous encounter.
changed_reading.after: Her utterance reverses the packet's immediately supplied agency map: the solicitor becomes household victim, and the person from whom evil was diverted becomes its alleged intending subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following conditional test explicitly opposes a frontal tear to a rear tear, ties direction to truth and falsehood, and culminates in visual inspection. The focus garment is therefore not decorative damage but a directional witness that can overturn first speech.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the lengthwise tear whose placement can be inspected.
Supplies the wearable object that persists after motion and can enter an evidentiary comparison.
Anchors the actual rear orientation that the later test treats as discriminating.
Supplies testimony articulated from knowledge and turns spatial direction into an explicit inference rule.
Supplies frontal opposition as the counterfactual orientation against which the rear tear is tested.
Repeats the rear condition in the branch of the test that reverses the woman's truth claim.
Supplies direct seeing as the operation that activates the garment's stored directional information.
Supplies the resulting classification as contrivance once the material trace defeats the first account.

structural_cues: 12:26-27 form a paired if-test with front and rear as mutually discriminating conditions.
12:28 repeats shirt, tear, and rear before the verdict, preserving the focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the orientation test and its truth assignments; I infer the causal arrow from rear grasp to pursuer and pursued. The live mechanical alternative that a rear tear could arise otherwise remains possible in isolation, but the packet's own test explicitly privileges this inference.

changed_reading.before: The torn shirt is vivid damage incurred during flight.
changed_reading.after: The shirt is a low-tech motion record: rear versus front preserves relative body direction and allows matter to answer a speech act.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the directional verdict, the immediate response seeks covering and non-circulation, but city speech later restores her as the soliciting subject and becomes heard. Her focus utterance is thus the first move in a reputation contest, not merely an interpersonal accusation.

activation_trace.role: Anchors her utterance as an intervention in the affair whose social settlement is at stake.
Anchors the disputed intention that competing speakers assign to different agents.
Supplies covering the offense and shielding its bearer from consequences, activating an attempted containment of exposure.
Supplies speech circulating among people and shows the affair escaping household control.
Restores solicitation with her as agent in the public retelling, reversing the focus attribution.
Supplies public clarity and makes the city's counterclassification openly legible.
Supplies social diffusion through hearing and confirms that the attempted cover has become reputation.

structural_cues: The master first commands disengagement and forgiveness, but the next ayah reports city women speaking.
The public report reverses the focus's subject assignment by saying that she solicits him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, public saying, restored solicitation, clarity, and hearing; I infer that her focus speech attempts narrative containment. A live alternative is that it seeks only immediate self-protection, with later circulation an unintended but independent development.

changed_reading.before: Her accusation is designed only to persuade the master standing at the door.
changed_reading.after: It is also a reputational counternarrative launched at first exposure; later circulation shows both why speed mattered and why the attempted containment failed.

context_deltas.mechanism: In the focus, desire and pursuit cut the garment while the body escapes injury. Later, seeing Joseph causes women to cut their own hands. The shirt can therefore be read as a displaced first wound in a sequence where visual or erotic capture becomes an involuntary mark on surfaces.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the first split as an elongated cut produced during the charged pursuit.
Supplies a covering adjacent to the body that receives the first damage in the body's place.
Supplies sight as the immediate perceptual trigger for the later bodily cuts.
Supplies actual severing on the later bodies and forms the material echo of the torn garment.
Locates the echoed damage on the bodily instruments holding the knives.

structural_cues: Both episodes place cutting next to attraction or pursuit centered on Joseph.
The first cut marks clothing from behind; the later cuts mark multiple hands after direct sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two cut events and the later sight trigger; I supply the displaced-wound relation between garment and skin. The live alternative is a thematic parallel with no implied transfer from body to clothing.

changed_reading.before: The shirt is accidentally damaged during a unique struggle.
changed_reading.after: The shirt receives the first displaced wound in a repeating cut-pattern, registering dangerous attraction before the same force reaches skin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later threat makes imprisonment conditional on Joseph's refusal to do what she commands, while his self-restraint is explicit. This retroactively activates the focus's legal-sounding penalty as leverage for compliance rather than neutral punishment for a completed offense.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the original proposal in the appearance of deserved act-for-act consequence.
Anchors imprisonment as the sanction whose function is revised by the later condition.
Supplies her continuing effort to overcome another's will and links the threat to the same solicitation.
Supplies active self-holding that prevents the solicited act and identifies the resistance the threat targets.
Supplies an imperative demand and changes the prison threat from retrospective sentence to prospective compulsion.
Repeats confinement in an explicit if-he-does-not-comply construction.
Adds humiliation as a coercive social outcome beyond mere physical detention.

structural_cues: 12:32 repeats solicitation and prison while explicitly inserting refusal of her command as the condition.
The later threat joins imprisonment with abasement, clarifying its disciplinary force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solicitation, self-restraint, command, conditional prison, and abasement; I infer that the focus's sanction already carries coercive leverage. A live alternative is development over time: the initial accusation may begin as self-protection and only later become openly coercive.

changed_reading.before: Prison is proposed as deserved punishment for an alleged prior intention.
changed_reading.after: Prison is also prospective leverage: the vocabulary of justice masks a device for overcoming refusal and enforcing the speaker's will.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph later prefers prison to the invitation and asks that their contrivance be turned away. The same enclosure threatened in 12:25 is thus reappropriated as a protective boundary; coercive capture and chosen refuge remain simultaneous readings.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the focus in a sought passage outward, the spatial value later transferred paradoxically to prison.
Anchors confinement as the hostile sentence that will be revalued.
Repeats the same enclosure as the object of Joseph's stated preference.
Supplies a comparative object of strongest preference and lets him reverse the sanction's imposed value.
Supplies verbal invitation as the force from which the enclosed alternative would protect him.
Supplies requested diversion and makes protection a matter of redirecting pressure away.
Supplies the contrivance against which prison can function as a resistant boundary.

structural_cues: The focus opposes the door's outward passage to threatened prison.
12:33 explicitly ranks prison above the repeated invitation while still naming the surrounding pressure as contrivance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threatened enclosure, later preference, invitation, and diversion of contrivance; I infer reappropriation of the sanction as refuge. The live alternative is only relative preference: prison remains wholly coercive but is judged the lesser harm.

changed_reading.before: Prison is the closed opposite of the door and therefore only a defeat of escape.
changed_reading.after: Prison remains coercive yet can also become a boundary Joseph chooses against invasive access, turning imposed closure into limited resistant agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: After signs have been seen, a new decision nevertheless appears to imprison him for a time. The focus's material evidence can reveal the event without governing institutional action; truth-discovery and outcome separate.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the material split that later functions as a readable sign of direction.
Anchors the rear orientation whose evidentiary force is established but not institutionally decisive.
Anchors the initially proposed confinement that eventually survives the exposure of contrary signs.

Supplies manifest signs and activates the tension between recognized indication and chosen outcome.

structural_cues: 12:35 grammatically places seeing the signs before the decision to imprison.
The local sequence has already made the shirt's rear tear a visible truth test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seen signs followed by a new prison decision; I infer that the focus garment belongs among the locally relevant signs and that authority overrides evidentiary force. The materially live alternative is that 12:35's signs are broader or different, so the decoupling is secure while the shirt-specific link remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: Once the shirt is read correctly, the material witness resolves the case.
changed_reading.after: The shirt can resolve what happened without controlling what power does; visible truth and institutional disposition become separate causal tracks.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ج ز ز mapping inside ج ز ي and aligns it with the literal shirt cut. It remains anchored in the packet's split mapping and the focus's adjacent tear-then-recompense sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material echo or latent activation, not as the lexical meaning or etymology of جزاء here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The shirt is cut, and the next speech asks for recompense whose QAC root is packet-mapped both to ج ز ي and ج ز ز.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the first literal severing in the garment.
Activates cutting within the non-dominant mapped inventory and lets punitive classification echo the preceding material severance.
Keeps the ordinary requital sense live so the second cut is a layered echo rather than a replacement meaning.

changed_reading.before: A physical tear is followed by a semantically unrelated legal question.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the speech performs a second cut: after cloth is split, punitive requital seeks to sever status, freedom, or belonging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the ق م ص agitation branch concerns leaping and instability rather than the ordinary noun 'shirt.' It remains anchored in the focus root inventory, the race, and the shirt's deformation under pursuit. Downstream prose should call it an activated material analogy, never a translation of قميص.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The raced-in and torn garment is the only object directly deformed by the opposing bodily motions.

activation_trace.role: Supplies rapid competing motion as the force the garment will register.
Activates leaping and instability, allowing the garment to be imagined as a surface animated by bodily turbulence.
Turns that turbulence into a stable longitudinal mark that can later be inspected.

changed_reading.before: The shirt is a passive possession that happens to tear.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the shirt behaves like a kinematic sensor: bodily agitation animates it, and the tear freezes that motion into a readable line.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the visible-person branch of س و د alongside, not instead of, the ordinary mastery branch. It remains anchored in سيدها, the finding verb, and the repeated door. Downstream prose should render it as scene geometry and sudden visibility, not as a claim that سيد lexically means silhouette here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: They suddenly find سيدها positioned at the same door toward which both have raced.

activation_trace.role: Supplies abrupt encounter and makes the third figure an unexpected visual interruption.
Activates the visible person-shape as the human figure suddenly occupying the exit line.
Keeps mastery and authority primary while the visible-figure branch supplies the spatial shock.
Locates the suddenly visible authority exactly in the passage that was supposed to enable escape.

changed_reading.before: The master is an authority whom they meet at a location.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, authority first arrives as a suddenly visible body occupying the escape aperture; the legal crisis begins as a spatial shock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the restraint and weaning branch inside ع ذ ب beneath the explicit punitive branch. It remains anchored in the stated alternative of prison or painful punishment and coheres with the verse's movement-to-restraint mechanism. Downstream prose should retain ordinary punishment as primary and offer withholding or deprivation only as a secondary texture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final phrase pairs confinement with a painful عذاب as the two exclusive sanctions.

activation_trace.role: Supplies spatial deprivation of movement as the first sanction.
Keeps inflicted punishment as the governing sense of the second sanction.
Adds withholding, prevention, or forced separation as a latent mechanism beneath the pain.
Requires the secondary withholding texture to remain genuinely injurious rather than euphemistic.

changed_reading.before: The alternatives are confinement or direct painful punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, both alternatives are modes of enforced deprivation: one withholds movement, while the other may inflict pain through prevention, separation, or withdrawal.

strongest_changes: The rear tear changes from vivid damage into a directional witness that can defeat the first spoken account.
The repeated recompense grammar sets the prior reward of good-doers against a human attempt to classify Joseph as intending evil.
The accusation reverses the immediately supplied agency map and redraws an honored household resident as an external threat.
Later conditional imprisonment reveals the legal-sounding penalty as coercive leverage, while Joseph's preference simultaneously revalues prison as refuge.
Seen signs do not control the eventual institutional decision, separating evidentiary truth from the exercise of power.
summary.what_was_special: This ayah converts motion into evidence and evidence into contested speech at a single threshold. Its live readings remain multiple: forensic reconstruction, reputational counternarrative, household boundary-making, penal valuation, coercive confinement, protective enclosure, and the material cut-series all coexist without collapsing into one verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The household-boundary reading depends on whether 'your household' invokes the full resident group or only the wife as intimate possession.
The market-to-penal pricing relation is a strong structural analogy but not an asserted lexical identity.
The garment-as-displaced-wound and non-dominant cut mapping are deliberately exploratory material activations.
The signs seen in 12:35 are locally compatible with the shirt evidence but are not exhaustively identified by the packet.
Joseph's preference for prison can be resistant reappropriation while remaining only a choice of the lesser harm.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Escape writes direction onto clothing.** س ب ق B001 (racing ahead), ق د د B001/B002 (lengthwise cutting; cut cloth), ق م ص B001 (shirt), and د ب ر B001 (rear) form a physical record. I infer that pursuit from behind causes the tear. The ayah reads as embodied evidence generated before either verbal claim.
2. **The doorway reverses control into accusation.** ب و ب B001 (entrance/door) first serves as the target of escape and then as the site of encounter; س ج ن B001 and ع ذ ب B005 supply proposed confinement and punishment. I infer that sudden public exposure prompts a narrative reversal in which the fleeing party is recast as aggressor.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:26-28 read the rear tear exactly as causal evidence, and 12:50-51 later made the same scene the basis for official exoneration.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A cut that distinguishes trajectories.** `ق د د:B001` is “lengthwise cutting and splitting”; dormant `ق د د:B005` is “managing by distinguishing and separating.” The ayah supplies a race toward one door, a shirt cut from behind, encounter at that door, and an immediate accusation; 12:26-28 turns the cut’s orientation into the discriminator between accounts. The packet supplies the material mark; I infer that its direction preserves who pursued whom. *Qaddat qamīṣahu min dubur* reads as an accidental forensic record that separates opposed narratives.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The shirt's rear tear is later recalled in the public inquiry of 12:50-51, while the same garment becomes restorative in 12:93-96; the cut's diagnostic force outlasts the immediate room and changes the shirt's role again.

baseline.text: İkisi kapıya doğru yarıştı. Kadın Yusuf'un gömleğini arkadan yırttı ve kapının yanında kadının efendisiyle karşılaştılar. Kadın, "Ailene kötülük yapmak isteyenin cezası hapsedilmek ya da acı bir azaptan başka ne olabilir?" dedi.

findings.text: Kapıya doğru kaçış sırasında gömleğin arkadan yırtılması, kimin çekildiğini ve kimin kovaladığını sözlerden önce kaydeden bedensel bir izdir.
Kapıdaki beklenmedik karşılaşma, kaçışı kamusal görünürlüğe çıkarınca baskı hemen tersine çevrilmiş bir suçlamaya dönüşür.

Geçici dal çerçevesi bunu doğru yakalar; yalnız yarışta konan pay, avcı kuş bağı ve takipten kaçıp kurtulma anlamları bu dalın çekirdeğine alınmamalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, hayvanın ya da işin hareket, koşu veya girişim içinde başkasından önce gelmesini ve yarışma yoluyla ön alma çabasını anlatır. Çekirdek, öne geçme ilişkisi iken karşılıklı yarışma bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı bir gerçekleşmesidir.

Koşuda veya benzeri bir karşılaşmada iki tarafın birbirini geçmeye çalışması yarışma yüzünü oluşturur.
Bir şeye önce davranma ya da bir işe başkalarından önce atılma, hareket çekirdeğinin iş ve girişim alanına taşınmasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, belirli türemiş biçimlerdeki son nokta ve sınır yeri kullanımlarını ayrı tutar; bunları yalın kökün genel anlamı olarak sunmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli türemiş biçimlerde, sınır, hesap ve benzeri alanlarda ulaşılan son noktayı bildirir; ayrı bir kullanımda bir sınır yerini veya ucu adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi enine değil boyuna doğru kesme veya yarma eylemini açıkça merkeze alır. Yarılma sonucu ve bu işte kullanılan demir araç, aynı çekirdeğe bağlı ikincil kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım boyuna kesme çekirdeğini korur; eylem, sonuç ve araç biçimleri birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi uzunluğu boyunca kesmek ya da boydan boya yarmaktır. Aynı çekirdeğe, böyle bir kesikle yarılma ve kesmede kullanılan demir araç da bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Kesme veya yarma, nesnenin uzunluğu boyunca yapılır; enine kesme bu sınırın dışındadır.
Eylemin sonucu, nesnenin boyuna doğru yarılması veya açılmasıdır.
Bu tür kesme işinde kullanılan demir araç da aynı anlam çevresinde adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yönü uzunlamasına olan kesme ve yarma anlamında birleşir; enine kesmeyi açıkça karşıt tutar ve yarılma sonucu ile kesme aracını da kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yön belirten temel eylemini, enine kesmeyle karışmayacak biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Uzunluk yönünü ve kesme ya da yarma işlemini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kesilmiş şey, tabaklanmamış deri şeritleri, oğlak derisi, deri kap, kurutulmuş et ve eski giysi gibi farklı adlandırmaları birlikte verir. Bunlar kesme sonucu çevresinde ilişkilidir, ancak tek bir nesne türüymüş gibi tanımlanmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kesilmiş ürün çekirdeğini biçimlere bağlar; atasözü niteliğindeki kullanım yalnız kendi kalıbıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Kesilerek parça veya şerit haline getirilmiş şeyleri ve bu işlemle bağlantılı kalıplaşmış nesne adlarını kapsar. Bunlar tabaklanmamış deri şeritleri ve deri kaplardan kurutulmuş ete, ayrıca eski giysi ve küçük işi büyütme söz kalıbına kadar ayrışır.

facets.statement: Temel bağıntı, bir nesnenin kesilmiş veya şerit halinde hazırlanmış ürün olmasıdır.
Tabaklanmamış deriden kesilen şerit, oğlak derisi, küçük deri kap ve deri kap bu çekirdeğin deri alanındaki adlarıdır.
Kurutulmuş et ile eskimiş giysi de kalıplaşmış nesne adları olarak bu dalda yer alır.
Belirli bir söz kalıbı, kişinin küçük bir işini gereğinden büyük hale getirmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kesilmiş şey ve deri şerit anlamlarını ortaklaştırır; ayrıca oğlak derisi, deri kap, kurutulmuş et, eski giysi ve küçük işi büyütme sözünü aynı anlam çevresinde toplar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القد بمعنى القامة وحسن الاعتدال والتقطيع في الجسم، وما ألحق به من طول ظهر الناقة القيدود.
يدخل فيه القدة والقدد بمعنى الطريقة، والفرقة من الناس، وتفرق القوم، وخاصة اختلاف الأهواء والطرائق.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir eylem biçiminde işleri yönetme, birbirinden ayırma, açıklığa kavuşturma ve sonuçlandırmayı birlikte verir. Bunlar rastgele ayırma değil, bir işi düzenleyip karara bağlama sürecinin parçalarıdır.

facets.statement: İş, ayrımlarını gözeterek düzenlenir ve yönetilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, belirli bir iş yönetme eylemini düzenleme, ayırt etme, bölümlerini açıklığa kavuşturma ve kesin biçimde sonuçlandırma bileşenleriyle açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Yönetme, ayırt etme, düzenleme ve sonuca bağlama bileşenlerini korur.

error_profile.loses: Ayırma, belirginleştirme ve kesin sonuca bağlama işlemlerini kaybeder.

root_profile.summary: Kökün ana anlam alanı boyuna kesme ve bundan doğan ürünler çevresindedir; beden boyu ve oranı, ayrışmış yollar ve gruplar, işleri ayırarak sonuçlandırma ve arazi aşma bu çekirdeğin daha uzak uzantılarıdır. Karın ağrısı, düz yer, yeterlik sözü, fiile bağlanan görev sözcüğü ve bal içeceği ise birbirinden ve ana kümeden belirgin biçimde ayrılan dallardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın giydiği bilinen gömleği, gömleği üzerine geçirip giymeyi, yönetim görevini üstlenme benzetmesini ve kalbin kılıfını birlikte destekler. Ancak örtü ya da kılıf uzantısı genel bir adlandırma değildir; kanıt bunu yalnızca kalbin kılıfıyla sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın gömlek adını ve giyme eylemini yapıya bağlı yönetim görevi benzetmesinden ayırır; kalbin kılıfı da özel bir adlandırma olarak kalır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın giydiği gömleği ve gömleği üzerine geçirerek giymeyi anlatır. Belirli kullanımlarda bu giyme görüntüsü yönetim görevini üstlenmeye aktarılır; kalbi saran kılıfa da gömlek adı verilir.

facets.statement: İnsan için bilinen bir giysi olan gömleği ve bu gömleği üzerine geçirip giymeyi kapsar.
Gömlek giyme görüntüsü, yalnızca belirtilen söz kalıbında bir yönetim görevini üstlenmek için kullanılır.
Kalbi saran kılıf, özel bir adlandırmayla gömlek diye anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak içeriği gömleği bilinen insan giysisi olarak tanır ve onu üzerine geçirip giymeyi aynı anlam alanına bağlar. Toplu kanıt ayrıca yönetim görevini üstlenme benzetmesini ve kalbin kılıfına verilen özel adı içerir.

error_profile.preserves: Gömlek nesnesini ve bu giysiyi üzerine geçirip giyme eylemini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz insanın giydiği bilinen giysiyi adlandırdığında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Giyme eylemini, yönetim görevi benzetmesini ve kalbin kılıfı kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın gerçek giysi çekirdeği gömlekle sınırlıdır ve yalnızca iki belirtilmiş uzantısı vardır; komşu dal ise giysiyle örtünmeyi ve çok çeşitli soyut örtüleri genel olarak anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل في هذا القميص المعروف ولبسه وتقمصه، وما يستعار للدخول في منصب أو ولاية، وما سمي قميصا لأنه غلاف أو ساتر.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi devenin, atın ya da başka bir hayvanın yerinde durmayıp sıçramasını; ön ayaklarını kaldırıp birlikte indirmesini ve arka ayaklarıyla tepinmesini açıkça verir. Deniz dalgalarının gemiyi böyle oynatması ile yerinde duramamaya yol açan rahatsızlık ve bağlantılı rivayet sözü de aynı hareket alanına bağlı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın sıçrama ve yerinde duramama adlarını hayvan, deniz ile gemi ve arka bacak kalıplarına bağlı özel kullanımlardan ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir hayvanın yerinde durmayıp sıçramasını, ön ayaklarını kaldırıp birlikte yere atarken arka ayaklarıyla tepinmesini anlatır. Aynı hareket görüntüsü dalgaların gemiyi oynatmasına aktarılır; yerinde duramamaya yol açan bir rahatsızlık ve bununla bağlantılı bir rivayet sözü de bu alana bağlanır.

facets.statement: Bir hayvan bulunduğu yerde durmaz, oradan sıçrar ve hareketli bir tepiniş gösterir.
Deve, at ya da başka bir hayvan ön ayaklarını kaldırıp birlikte yere atarken arka ayaklarıyla tepinir.
Belirtilen deniz ve gemi yapısında dalgalar gemiyi, sıçrayan bir hayvanı andıracak biçimde oynatır.
Yerinde duramamaya yol açan bir rahatsızlık ya da huzursuzluk durumu aynı hareket adıyla anılır.
Bağımsız bir tanımı verilmeyen bir rivayet sözü de sıçrama ve hareket alanına bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt hayvanın yerinde durmayıp sıçramasını ayrıntılı bir ayak hareketiyle açıklar: ön ayaklar kaldırılıp birlikte indirilir, arka ayaklarla tepinilir. Aynı hareket dalgaların gemiyi oynatmasına aktarılır; yerinde duramamaya yol açan bir rahatsızlık ve bağlantılı bir rivayet sözü de bu anlam alanında anılır.

Rüzgâr, gök cismi, böcek topluluğu, tarla bölmesi, yara, oyun oku ve güreş tutuşu gibi dallar bu genişlemenin yerleşmiş özel alanlarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyi bulmayı ve bir kimseye rastlayıp onunla karşılaşmayı açıkça eş değer kullanım alanları olarak verir. Bu nedenle bulma ve karşılaşma çerçevesi, kaynağın belirlediği anlam sınırını doğrudan yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam bağımsız eylem biçiminde tanıklanır; tanım herhangi bir özel kalıba, aranan nesneye veya rastlantı koşuluna bağlanmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bulunduğu yerde bulmak ya da bir kimseye rastlayıp onunla karşılaşmaktır. Bulmanın önceden arama yapmayı, karşılaşmanın da mutlaka rastlantıyı gerektirdiği söylenmez.

facets.statement: Bir nesne, durum veya olgu bulunduğu yerde görülür ve varlığı belirlenir.
Bir kimseye rastlanır ve onunla karşı karşıya gelinir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bir şeyi bulma ile bir kimseye rastlayıp karşılaşma, aynı eylemin nesneye ve kişiye göre değişen görünümleri olarak ortak biçimde desteklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nesne bulmayı ve kişiyle karşılaşmayı birlikte kapsayan kısa ve doğal üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi bulma ile bir kimseye rastlama yönlerinin ikisini de korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesne, durum veya olgunun bulunduğu yerde görülmesi ve varlığının belirlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin bulunduğu yerde görülüp belirlenmesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir kimseye rastlayıp onunla karşılaşma yönünü tek başına açıkça taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimseyle karşı karşıya gelme veya ona bulunduğu yerde denk gelme bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kimseyle karşılaşma ve ona denk gelme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir nesneyi bulma yönünü tek başına tam olarak kapsamaz.
error_profile.collision: Güncel kullanımda olayın rastlantısal olduğu izlenimini gereğinden fazla güçlendirebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir kimseye rastlama, onu bulma ve onunla karşı karşıya gelme alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol kişiyle karşılaşmanın yanında nesne bulmayı da kapsar ve rastlantıyı zorunlu kılmaz; komşu kol kişiyle rastlantısal karşılaşmaya daha sıkı bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir şeyi bulma ve ona erişme sonucunda birleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol bulmayı özel bir arama, başarı veya kavrama koşuluna bağlamaz; komşu kol hedefe ulaşma ve duyusal ya da zihinsel kavrama yönleriyle daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşılaşılan şeyi ele geçirme veya üzerinde üstünlük kurma sonucu olmadan da gerçekleşir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim ve belirli iki şey arasında kurulan kalıp birlikte bulunur; tanım ikisini parçaları bağlama çekirdeğinde ayırarak kapsar.

Farklı parçaları düzenli bir sıraya koyarak bir eser veya bütün oluşturmak bu çekirdeğin düzenleme yönüdür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı bir insanın veya başka bir şeyin görünen kişiliği, gövdesi ya da silueti olarak tanımlar. Eşya siluetlerine ilişkin çoğul kullanım da aynı görsel çekirdeğin örneğidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak biçimin görünür siluet anlamıyla sınırlıdır; renk, gizli konuşma veya özel bir söz öbeğine bağlı anlam buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın veya başka bir şeyin gözle seçilen bütünsel gövdesi, görünüşü ya da siluetidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, insanın veya herhangi bir şeyin gözle seçilen bütünsel siluetidir.
Eşyanın ayrı ayrı görünen siluetleri, bu görsel anlamın çoğul bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, insanın veya bir şeyin gözle görünen bütünsel siluetini ortak anlam olarak verir; eşya siluetleri de bunun örneğidir.

concept_gloss.text: görünür kişi ya da nesne silueti
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir insanın veya nesnenin ayrıntılarından çok bütünsel görünüşünün seçildiği bağlamlar için uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Kişi veya nesnenin görünür gövdesi anlamındaki daha geniş kapsamı açıkça söylemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birden çok eşyanın uzaktan veya topluca seçilen görünüşlerinden söz edilen bağlama özgüdür.

error_profile.loses: İnsanları ve diğer nesne türlerini kapsayan genel çekirdeği daraltır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana ekseni bir topluluk içinde üstünlük, iyilikte öne çıkma ve önderliktir. Eş için kullanılan özel anlam ile insanların önderin varlığına sığınmasına dayanan adlandırma açıklaması aynı çekirdeğin zorunlu parçaları değil, ayrıca sınırlandırılması gereken kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak önder ve üstünlük biçimlerini, önder yapılma eylemlerini ve eşe özgü kullanımı ayrı katmanlarda tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin kendi topluluğu içinde iyilik, konum veya yönetme gücü bakımından üstün olup onlara önderlik etmesidir. Eş için kullanılan anlam bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, kişinin kendi topluluğu içinde iyilik veya yönetim bakımından üstün olup önder konumuna gelmesidir.
Bir kadının eşi için kullanılan koca anlamı, önderlik çekirdeğinin özel bir toplumsal kullanımıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak sözü, önce karşılıklı karşılık verme yarışını, ardından konuşanın öteki tarafa üstün gelmesini kuran sabit diziyi açıkça bildirir. Bu nedenle üstün gelme, genel karşılık verme anlamına değil yalnızca bu yapının sonucuna aittir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Birleştirilmiş kaynak ifadesi, saçın, yünün ve çeşitli bitkilerin kırkılarak ya da biçilerek kesilmesini ortak çekirdek olarak açıkça destekler. Alet ve yünü kırkılan hayvanlar bu eyleme bağlı adlandırmalardır; ayrı bir eylem çekirdeği oluşturmaz.

concept_map.definition: Saçı, yünü, otu, ekini veya benzeri bir şeyi kırkarak ya da biçerek kesme eylemidir. Bu eyleme yarayan alet ile yünü kırkılan koyunlar, çekirdeğe bağlı adlandırmalardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir seyi dileme ve ona yonelme cekirdegini; amaclamayi, icten gelen egilimi ve belirli soz kaliplarinda hukme baglama ya da buyruk bildirme kullanimlarini birlikte verir. Hazirlanan dal cercevesi bu cekirdek ile kullanima bagli uzantilari ayirdigi icin korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yalniz basina kullanilan dileme ve yonelme anlamiyla belirli soz dizilerinde ortaya cikan hukme baglama ve buyruk anlamlarini ayri tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyi dilemeyi, ona dogru icten yonelmeyi ve onu yapmayi ya da elde etmeyi amaclamayi anlatir. Belirli soz dizilerinde bir seyi oyle diye hukme baglama veya birinden bir sey yapmasini isteme yoluyla buyruk bildirme anlamina genisler.

facets.statement: Bir seyi dilemek ve benligin o seye dogru yonelmesidir.
Dilemenin belirli bir isi yapmayi ya da bir sonuca ulasmayi amaclama yonudur.
Yaraticiya baglanan belirli bir soz dizisinde, bir seyi oyle diye hukme baglamayi bildirir.
Birinden belirli bir sey istendigini bildiren soz dizisinde buyruk degeri tasir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: راودته على كذا مراودة وروادا، أي أردته (sihah)؛ المراودة أن تنازع غيرك في الإرادة (mufradat)؛ تصرفه عن رأيه (mufradat)؛ راودته على أن يفعل كذا إذا أردته على فعله (maqayis)؛ يرادى مقلوب ومعناه يراود (maqayis-crossref)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه راد الكلأ وارتاده بمعنى طلبه، والرائد المرسل أو الطالب للكلإ، والرجل الرأد بمعنى الرائد.
يدخل فيه راد الشيء إذا جاء وذهب، ورياد الإبل واختلافها في المرعى، والمراد موضع التردد، ورادت المرأة إلى بيوت جاراتها، وراد وساده إذا لم يستقر.
يدخل فيه أرود في السير إذا رفق، والمشي على رود، ورويد ورويدك بمعنى مهلا وأمهل، والرادة من الرياح السهلة التي لا تهب بشدة.
يدخل فيه الرائد بمعنى يد الرحى أو العود الذي تدار به، والمرود بمعنى الميل والحديدة التي تدور في اللجام ومحور البكرة من حديد.
يدخل فيه رائد العين، أي عوارها الذي يرود فيها.
يدخل فيه جارية رود بمعنى شابة، ومعها الرؤدة والرأدة بالهمز في الصحاح بمعنى الشابة الحسنة.
